title: Beef Pirozhki Stew
description: A hearty beef stew made with smoked beef, corned beef, and a hint of russian spices, served with crispy pirozhki on the side.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the smoked beef and corned beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the beef broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve with pirozhki on the side.
To make the pirozhki, preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Cut the pirozhki in half and place on a baking sheet.
Brush with oil and bake for 5-7 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
